en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's play dodgeball
I'll be the referee
Let's burn this place to the ground
Got it! I'm aces at dodgeball!

If you can, try gettin' my big, beautiful tits out
by aimin' the ball at me!

Try gettin' my big, beautiful tits out
by aimin' the ball at me!
<CLT=cltMIND>...Why did she say it twice?
Huh? You wanna be the referee?

Are you one of those sick fucks that gets
off on watching!?
Unfortunately for you, I'm not into that.

But...I feel inspired to work on my next
invention.

Alright, Shuichi!
You can start without me!

Do you wanna use my "Instaburn"
invention?

It's for burning up social media accounts owned
by ugly bitches who take too many selfies!

It won't cause burning anywhere else!
Trust me, it's been tested!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Miu looks deep in thought...
(Hmph...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Miu's inner thoughts...?
